mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the arm to the breathing supply circuit was most worthwhile because the result brings oxygen and nutrient delivery, carbon dioxide return and lymph drainage into one picture.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the collecting vessels was the least engaging step: it was a predictable link, and its result added little explanation beyond the picture.

surprise.text: I found it useful to learn that body movement and breathing help move lymph, while valves limit backward flow.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; each added a plausible part of the route from tissue spaces back to blood.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it developed these connections further, though the mostly predictable assembly steps offered limited challenge.
